title: TCL is right to question Samsung’s use of the term “Mini LED”
summary: TCL challenges Samsung's use of the "Mini LED" term, questioning whether displays without full-array local dimming (FALD) technology deserve the classification. The dispute raises concerns about industry standardization and accurate marketing of display technologies.
content: Can it be Mini LED without a FALD backlight?

zh.title: TCL有理由质疑三星对"Mini LED"术语的使用
zh.summary: TCL质疑三星对"Mini LED"术语的使用，质疑不具有全阵列局部调光(FALD)技术的显示屏是否应该获得此分类。这场争议引发了人们对行业标准化和显示技术准确营销的担忧。

title: Robotaxi operators will face fines for blocking first responders
summary: California enacts new law imposing fines on autonomous vehicle operators that block emergency first responders. This regulatory action addresses safety concerns as robotaxi services expand.
content: A new California law places new rules on autonomous vehicles operators

zh.title: 无人出租车运营商因阻挡急救人员将面临罚款
zh.summary: 加州制定新法律，对阻挡紧急救援人员的自动驾驶汽车运营商实施罚款。这一监管行动解决了随着无人出租车服务扩展而产生的安全问题。

title: The founder’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know
